title: Separate external messages from operational activity while preserving navigation/deep links.
changes: Added one authority-neutral Feed/Inbox routing contract.
External customer/client/lead communication routes to Inbox lifecycle ownership.
Operational/workforce/job/execution activity remains on the operational Feed projection.
Contradictory external+operational signals fail closed instead of silently mixing lifecycle ownership.
Navigation and deep-link context is preserved across route/view/url/thread/message/conversation/entity references.
Unsafe script-style deep links are rejected.
No visible shell/page-wiring hotspot was modified.
